description: Election Commission - Mr. G. D. Somasiri of the Horana Urban Council has vacated his Office of member of that Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Horana Urban Council has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a declaration made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the status of an elected local government official, which falls under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections.
